page_title: LEC 2-3 ACM | Lecce v AC Milan 08/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
90+1' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
88' Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) has tested the patience of referee Daniele Doveri and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
87' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) reacts quickest to a cross from Antonino Gallo, but slams his header well wide of the left post from around the penalty spot.
85' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) meets a cross inside the box, but Marco Sportiello wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
85' Lameck Banda (Lecce) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
84' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) is caught offside!
82' Substitution. Lassana Coulibaly makes way for Ante Rebic (Lecce).
82' Marco Giampaolo has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lameck Banda (Lecce) replacing Tete Morente.
81' 2 - 3 Goal! Rafael Leao puts a cross into the box and finds Christian Pulisic (AC Milan), who latches on to it and strikes the ball low into the middle of the net. He makes it 2:3.
80' A pass lands at the feet of Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
80' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
80' A quickly taken corner by AC Milan.
79' Riccardo Sottil (AC Milan) serves up a nice cross, but Wladimiro Falcone punches the ball away. The ball is out of play and AC Milan manage to earn a corner.
79' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
77' The ball falls to Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) on the edge of the box, but his shot goes well wide of the goal.

76' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Daniele Doveri with no other option than to blow for a foul.
75' Substitution. Yunus Musah leaves the pitch and is replaced by Riccardo Sottil (AC Milan).
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kyle Walker leaves the pitch and Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) comes on.
74' Marco Giampaolo decides to make a substitution. Santiago Pierotti will be replaced by Danilo Veiga (Lecce).
74' That will be all from Thorir Johann Helgason who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Ylber Ramadani (Lecce).
73' 2 - 2 Goal! Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Wladimiro Falcone into the roof of the net.
73' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) is going to take the penalty!
72' Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for a foul after Federico Baschirotto (Lecce) hacks down one of his opponents. AC Milan are awarded a penalty! What an opportunity to score.
71' Kyle Walker (AC Milan) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.

70' The flag is raised by the referee's assistant. Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) is repeatedly being caught offside. He's always hanging on the shoulder of the last man to try and get into a scoring position.
68' 2 - 1 This is definitely not what Antonino Gallo (Lecce) wanted. Attempting to intercept an offensive pass, he scored an own goal and made it 2:1.
67' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
66' Ball possession – 25:75.
64' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) sprays a pass out to Rafael Leao, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
62' Warren Bondo will be replaced by Joao Felix (AC Milan).
62' Sergio Conceicao prepares a substitution. Santiago Tomas Gimenez is replaced by Tammy Abraham (AC Milan).
59' 2 - 0 Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) scores! He latches on to a pass and produces a perfect strike from the edge of the box that goes inside the left post and past the goalkeeper.
56' The manager makes a subsitution with Balthazar Pierret (Lecce) coming on for Medon Berisha.
55' What a wasted chance that was! A precise cross into the box finds Yunus Musah (AC Milan), whose header goes wide of the goal.
54' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Malick Thiaw (AC Milan), but it's just over the bar.
53' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
53' Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) spurns a big chance! He got to the rebound but only hit the right post!
53' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
50' The ball is cleared after Tete Morente (Lecce) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
49' Some neat passing and movement from AC Milan as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
47' The foul by Tete Morente (Lecce) was seen by Daniele Doveri who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
46' Half-time substitution. Sergio Conceicao decided to make a change. Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) is replaced by Rafael Leao.
46' The whistle blows and Daniele Doveri starts the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Referee Daniele Doveri halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Sergio Conceicao, then shows him a yellow.
45+2' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
44' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Wladimiro Falcone intercepts the ball.
43' Medon Berisha (Lecce) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Daniele Doveri had an easy-decision to make.
42' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

41' Great save! Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Wladimiro Falcone.
40' AC Milan will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
40' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
38' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
37' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
34' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
33' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Wladimiro Falcone.
31' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
31' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
28' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) passes the ball onto Santiago Tomas Gimenez, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
26' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
23' Lecce force a corner. They send men into the box.
23' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the right post.
21' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) expertly controls a neat clever pass inside the box, but his effort crashes against the left post! What an opportunity that was!
20' The current number of shots on goal is 1:2.
17' The AC Milan players are exchanging some short passes and control the game at the moment, but one of the defending players steps in and intercepts the ball.
15' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The AC Milan players look gutted.
15' The AC Milan players halt their celebrations as referee Daniele Doveri makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
15' A cross from the free kick is whipped deep into the box by Theo Hernandez and Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) gets in a shot, sending the ball inside the left post. 1:1.
14' It seemed like Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
11' The AC Milan players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
8' A snap shot by Yunus Musah (AC Milan) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Wladimiro Falcone produces a good save to thwart him.
7' 1 - 0 Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) scores! He latches on to a pass and produces a perfect strike from the edge of the box. The ball goes into the bottom right corner and past the goalkeeper.
6' Good work from AC Milan as they win a corner.
5' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
4' Tete Morente (Lecce) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
1' The goal by AC Milan is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
1' Wait! Referee Daniele Doveri has indicated he is going to review the AC Milan goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
1' It's 0:1! Theo Hernandez feeds Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom right corner.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and AC Milan will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Daniele Doveri.
